free_tier.stated: CVM-4GB-M at USD 6/month: 2 vCPU (AMD EPYC Milan), 4 GB DDR4, 30 GB NVMe Gen4 on RAID-10, 1 TB premium bandwidth, in Johor Bahru, Malaysia (Equinix JH1). The Premium line's CVM-4GB is USD 7/month with the same 30 GB on EPYC Genoa and DDR5.

egress.terms: 1 TB a month of premium bandwidth per plan, with no overage price and no throttle stated on the page read

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: the page names a self-service 'Cloud Panel' and a client portal at clients.terabix.net, plus a looking glass at lg.terabix.net; no API is documented on the page read
chaining: 2 vCPU and 4 GB for USD 6 with a Singapore-adjacent location makes this the only South-East Asian host at that shape, so it fits an APAC crawl edge or a regional DNS probe; it is not the cheapest 4 GB here, because TNAHosting sells 4 GB for USD 5

limits.value: 1 TB a month of 'Premium Bandwidth' is stated per plan; the page publishes no overage rate, so the allowance is the wall and the port speed is not stated on the page read
